Roguelike Celebration 2021

Watch talk recordings on YouTube

Read our transparency report

Roguelike Celebration 2021 was on Saturday and Sunday October 16th and 17th, 2021 as a virtual event in our custom-built multiplayer game/chat space. All talks were also live-streamed on Twitch and YouTube for free.
